Retrieve SPI output data from GitHub

Source: R/spi-data.R
spi_get.Rd

Downloads one of the three core SPI output datasets from the World Bank SPI GitHub repository and optionally filters the result. For a more focused API, see the convenience wrappers spi_data(), spi_index(), and spi_aggregates().

spi_get(
  type = "data",
  version = "master",
  country = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  pillar = NULL,
  dimension = NULL,
  region = NULL
)

Arguments

type

Character. Which dataset to retrieve:

  • "data" — SPI_data.csv: individual indicator scores per country-year (wide format).

  • "index" — SPI_index.csv: pillar and overall SPI index scores per country-year (wide format).

  • "aggregates" — regional aggregate scores (long format, regions only — individual countries are excluded).

version

Character. Branch name in the SPI repository. Defaults to "master" (the latest stable version). Use spi_versions() to list available branches.

country

Character vector of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g. c("NOR", "SWE")). Applies to type = "data" and type = "index" only. NULL returns all countries.

year

Integer vector of years (e.g. 2023:2024). Applies to all types. NULL returns all years.

pillar

Integer (1-5). Restricts indicator columns to the specified SPI pillar. For "data" and "index": column subsetting. For "aggregates": row filtering on source_id. NULL returns all pillars. Ignored when dimension is also supplied.

dimension

Character in "P.D" format (e.g. "5.2", "1.5"). Restricts to a specific dimension. More specific than pillar; when both are supplied, dimension takes precedence. NULL returns all dimensions.

region

Character vector of region names (e.g. "Africa Eastern and Southern"). Applies to type = "aggregates" only. NULL returns all regions.

Value

A data.table. For "data" and "index": wide format with one row per country-year. For "aggregates": long format with one row per region-year-indicator.

See also

spi_data(), spi_index(), spi_aggregates(), spi_versions()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Full SPI data for all countries
spi_get("data")

# Norway and Sweden, year 2024, Pillar 3 columns only
spi_get("data", country = c("NOR", "SWE"), year = 2024, pillar = 3)

# SPI index, dimension 5.2 only
spi_get("index", dimension = "5.2")

# Regional aggregates for Africa, Pillar 1
spi_get("aggregates",
  region = "Africa Eastern and Southern",
  pillar = 1
)

# Use a specific version (branch)
spi_get("data", version = "SPI2023")
} # }
